faq.label: FAQ
faq.headline: Before you
faq.intro: The questions founders ask on the first call, answered up front.

items.a: Usually within a week. Book a call and we will confirm the start date on it.

items.q: Do I own the code and designs?
items.a: Yes. Everything made for your product is yours at handover. We keep the right to reuse generic building blocks in AI Library, never your brand, content or product design.

items.q: Do you work with teams outside India?
items.a: Yes. The studio is based in Bangalore and works with founders in any time zone, async first with calls when they help.
Next.js and TypeScript for the web, with Postgres and Vercel or Cloudflare behind it. Swift and Rust when the product needs them.

items.q: Can I hire you for design only?
items.a: Yes. You get screens and a design system your engineers can build without guessing, and we stay on call while they do.
You get 14 days of fixes included. After that you can keep us on call monthly or take it from there with the code and docs.
